response.sql: WITH rating_prices AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS average_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_per_day_price FROM rating_prices) SELECT rp.rating, rp.average_replacement_cost, rp.per_day_price, rp.per_day_price / o.mean_per_day_price AS relative_per_day_price FROM rating_prices AS rp CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_per_day_price IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The rating’s per-day price is the average of each film’s rental_rate divided by its rental_duration.

alternatives.interpretation: Divide each rating’s average rental_rate by its average rental_duration.
